items.title: tiny-voca: 4.5M-parameter text-to-speech model that runs on a CPU and in the browser
items.summary: A 4.5M-parameter, roughly 18 MB TTS model trained on synthetic voices that runs on a CPU. Repliers report it works on an old Android tablet and a reply says it ranks among the smallest models in the top 10 of the Open TTS Leaderboard on English WER; the author reports about 1 in 100 words wrong, mostly names.

reception.summary: Repliers praise it; one tested it on a 7 year old Android tablet and it worked, another cites a top-10 English WER ranking on the Open TTS Leaderboard, a few ask for language variants (an Italian version was posted).

items.title: Open Vision Banana: open recipe and Flux 2 klein finetunes for generative visual perception
items.summary: Flux 2 klein 4B/9B finetunes trained for visual perception tasks with a fully open recipe, with a public demo Space.

items.title: Seedance 2.5 with 4K output available on fal for text, image and reference to video
items.summary: ByteDance Seedance 2.5 4K video generation is callable through fal endpoints for text-to-video, image-to-video and reference-to-video.

items.title: LeRobot 0.7 adds YAM, reBot B601 and Unitree G1 with SONIC support
items.summary: LeRobot 0.7 adds support for the I2RT YAM arm (one or two arms, gravity feed-forward from the arm model), the Seeed reBot B601 and the Unitree G1 with SONIC, with docs for each.

items.title: Drama 3 TTS shrunk from 38.6 GB to 14.5 GB with 3-bit NVFP4 pruned quant, word errors held on 24 test lines
items.summary: A pruned NVFP4 quant of Fish Audio's Drama 3 is up on Hugging Face with a recipe repo; the author reports unchanged word errors on the same 24 test lines (a small test set).

doubt.pushback: Only 24 test lines were used for the word-error check.

items.title: PyBot: a chatbot with no model weights, built as about 600k lines of Python rules by a swarm of 1,000 agents
items.summary: Hugging Face had 1,000 DeepSeek Flash agents write a rule-based chatbot in pure Python with no weights or training, as a test of what agent swarms can produce; chat Space and repo are public.

doubt.pushback: Framed as a stunt; a demonstration of swarm output, not a capable assistant.

items.title: DeepSeek open-sources a chat frontend demo
items.summary: DeepSeek published a chat-demo frontend repo; NielsRogge reports pointing Claude at it to improve a chat interface.

doubt.pushback: Second-hand report; repo contents not inspected.

items.title: OpenBMB reports an additive power-law scaling law for long-context perplexity (LongPPL)
items.summary: OpenBMB reports an empirical law on log(LongPPL) as a function of model size and short and long-context token counts that extrapolates to held-out scales; the post shows a chart and no linked paper or code.

doubt.pushback: No paper or code linked in the post.
